comment: The scripts and docs both IDE plugins bundle. moe-jetbrains/build.gradle.kts (prepareSandbox) and moe-vscode/scripts/bundle-assets.mjs both read this file. Each copy goes from `from` (repo-relative) to `into` (bundle-relative). With `files`, it copies exactly those files, each of which must exist, and LF-normalises any .sh among them. Without `files`, it copies the whole directory minus `exclude` (Ant-style patterns relative to `from`, the syntax Gradle's exclude() takes), and each `required` file must exist. A missing source, or a path that is absolute or has a .. segment, fails both builds. The daemon and proxy copies stay in each build, next to their fresh-dist checks.
